d02-ana-thumbs-up-at-home.observed_description: Ana sits at her wooden kitchen table in warm early-evening lamp light (a dark window sliver at the right), sage overshirt over a white top, turned toward the left in three-quarter view and smiling broadly at Luis off-frame, not at the camera; her right arm reaches out toward him with one large thumbs-up seen from the side against plain white cabinets, four fingers curled, thumb straight up; her left hand rests beside a plain white mug and her brown tote hangs on the chair. Identity matches revision 1 and photo t22. Reads as a cheerful OK at 180 px. The centered 4:5 crop cuts off the hand, so the picture must stay out of four-picture banks; it is bound only as a reply-turn picture, which the app shows in the 3:2 prompt frame (image_choices false).

d01-ana-thumbs-down-at-work.observed_description: Ana sits at her light-oak office desk in late-afternoon sun, still working (left hand flat on a thick stack of papers beside an open folder, an open grey laptop angled away at the right with no visible screen, brown tote unpacked on the navy chair at the left). She looks off to the left toward Luis, not at the camera, with a wry closed-mouth smile and raised eyebrows, and holds one large thumbs-down out toward him, thumb straight down. Expression is less regretful than prompted but not hostile. Identity matches revision 1 and photo 03; papers show only illegible faint lines. Reads as a clear no at 180 px; the 4:5 crop keeps her face, the thumbs-down hand and the papers.
